{{Top|leg}}
'''Laser dice''' were a type of [[Chance cube/Legends|cubes]] that were used for games of chance. The young [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Stuart Zissu]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[4B-X]] once met a couple of cave dwellers on [[Da'nor]] who wore laser dice hanging on their [[Belt/Legends|belts]].<ref name="science">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''
